name: Hollow Touch
description: A touch of nothing.

name: Shadow Nip
description: A bite of shadow that feeds the user. The user regains 50% of the damage dealt.

name: Dim Light
description: The world dims for the target. Blinded for 2 turns.

name: Null Pulse
description: A pulse that empties a little SP. Drains 2 SP.

name: Existential Hiccup
description: Reality skips. Damage may follow. Its damage varies wildly: 20% to 220% of normal.

name: Void Lance
description: A lance of nothing.

name: Gravity Well
description: Pulls the target in. Drags the target 2 tiles toward the user.

name: Entropy Touch
description: Takes a slice of the target's max HP. Takes 12% of the target's max HP, ignoring its defence.

name: Umbra Bite
description: A bite that feeds the user. The user regains 50% of the damage dealt.

name: Void Pun
description: The groan is the weapon. The foe is silenced a turn. Silenced (no skills) for 1 turn.

name: Rift Slash
description: Two cuts through the air itself. Strikes 2 times.

name: Black Hole Pinch
description: A tiny hole that drags in everything near the aim. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Drags the target 1 tile toward the user.

name: Soul Rend
description: Tears at a weakened soul. +50% damage on a target at 30% HP or less.

name: Erase
description: Takes a big slice of the target's max HP. Takes 18% of the target's max HP, ignoring its defence.

name: Cosmic Wedgie
description: Yank! Dragged in and left exposed. Exposed (25% more damage) for 1 turn. Drags the target 2 tiles toward the user.

name: Abyssal Maw
description: A mouth of nothing over the area. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one.

name: Event Horizon
description: Drags the target in and leaves it open. Exposed (25% more damage) for 2 turns. Drags the target 3 tiles toward the user.

name: Null Field
description: Empties the SP of everyone near the aim and silences them. Reaches every tile within 1 of the aimed one. Silenced (no skills) for 1 turn. Drains 4 SP.

name: Stare Into Abyss
description: It stares back. The target loses a slice of HP and its sight; so does the user's calm. Takes 15% of the target's max HP, ignoring its defence. Blinded for 2 turns. The user takes 5% of max HP in recoil.

name: Collapse
description: Everything near the aim folds in. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one.

name: Oblivion
description: Takes a great slice of the target's max HP. Takes 30% of the target's max HP, ignoring its defence.

name: Unmake
description: Finishes what is nearly gone. +80% damage on a target at 30% HP or less.

name: Singularity
description: A point that swallows the area and pulls it in. Reaches every tile within 2 of the aimed one. Drags the target 2 tiles toward the user.

name: Annihilate
description: Takes almost half of the target's max HP. It costs the user. Takes 45% of the target's max HP, ignoring its defence. The user takes 10% of max HP in recoil.
